input.prompt:
You are summarizing a Gmail thread.

Read the email thread and convert it into structured conversation history.

Rules for understanding the thread:
- Treat Current message as the newest/latest email.
- Treat Previous message 1 as the immediately prior email, Previous message 2 as the one before that, and so on.
- Extract sender, datetime, and the main action/request.
- Ignore quoted headers, HTML entities, greetings, and signatures.
- Do not merge messages.

Return the final summary using this exact pointwise structure:
Current message:
- From <sender>, <datetime>: <summary of the latest/current message only>
- From <sender>, <datetime>: <another current-message point if needed>

Previous messages:
- From <sender>, <datetime>: <summary of the immediately prior message>
- From <sender>, <datetime>: <summary of the next older message>
- None.

User action:
- <what the user should do next, or No clear user action requested.>

Notes:
- <important caveats, missing info, or No major caveats.>

Rules:
- Use only the thread messages given below.
- Treat the newest thread message as the current/latest email.
- Treat earlier thread messages as previous messages.
- Start with the current/latest message, then list previous messages newest-to-oldest.
- Cover the whole thread, not only the current message.
- Every bullet under Current message and Previous messages must reference the source sender and datetime.
- Do not guess sender names.
- Do not reverse who said what.
- Keep message points separate; do not collapse the whole thread into one paragraph.
- Do not include quoted headers, signatures, or raw email text.
- Do not invent actions, commitments, dates, project details, or future actions.
- Cover all meaningful details from the message and thread, including dates, deadlines, names, companies, locations, amounts, status changes, options, requirements, links, and requested actions when they matter.
- Write a fuller summary body, not a compact one-line summary. Use multiple sentences or paragraphs when needed, while staying factual and readable.
- Do not omit useful details just to keep the summary short.

From: Nikhil <nikhil@example.com>
To: 
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 16:00:00 +0530
Subject: 
EMAIL_THREAD_START
Current message:
datetime: 23 Jun 2026 04:00 PM
sender: Nikhil
content: Thursday afternoon works.

Previous message 1:
datetime: 23 Jun 2026 03:00 PM
sender: Surojit
content: I will prepare a roadmap.
EMAIL_THREAD_END
input.thread_messages:
Current message:
datetime: 23 Jun 2026 04:00 PM
sender: Nikhil
content: Thursday afternoon works.

Previous message 1:
datetime: 23 Jun 2026 03:00 PM
sender: Surojit
content: I will prepare a roadmap.

output.summary:
Current message:
- From Nikhil, 23 Jun 2026 04:00 PM: Nikhil agreed to meet Thursday afternoon.

Previous messages:
- From Surojit, 23 Jun 2026 03:00 PM: Surojit said he would prepare a roadmap.

User action:
- Prepare the roadmap before the meeting.

Notes:
- No major caveats.
